title: Canada Leader Answers Trump's "Lake America" With Giant "Lake Ontario" Sign
summary_full: Ontario Premier Doug Ford answered President Donald Trump's "Lake America" decree Saturday with a billboard-sized message on the Canadian shoreline - "Lake Ontario. Now and Always" - as Canadian leaders met the move with ridicule rather than outrage.
